title: Growth Charts and Growth Velocity: Clinical Interpretation
subject: Developmental Milestones
preview: Growth requires serial measurements with correctly chosen age- and sex-appropriate charts.
quickRevision: Growth requires serial measurements with correctly chosen age- and sex-appropriate charts.
Interpret weight, length or height and head circumference in context of prematurity and family pattern.
Incorrect technique or plotting can create false alarm; verify measurements before concluding.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: Growth requires serial measurements with correctly chosen age- and sex-appropriate charts.
Growth velocity and crossing centile channels can reveal concerns that one isolated percentile misses.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Being at a low percentile is not itself a diagnosis without trend and clinical context.

quiz.question: What is more informative than a single height percentile?
quiz.explanation: Serial growth velocity. Growth velocity and crossing centile channels can reveal concerns that one isolated percentile misses.
